raw_text: Fresh Myanmar military airstrikes in Chin State have sent shockwaves — literally — across the border into Mizoram. Residents of Champhai town, the nearest Indian settlement, reported hearing multiple explosions before dawn on Wednesday. The Indian Army's 57 Mountain Division has placed forward units on alert. Mizoram Chief Minister Lalduhoma urged the Centre to provide immediate humanitarian assistance for incoming refugees.
clean_text: Myanmar airstrikes in Chin State heard in Champhai, Mizoram. Indian Army 57 Mountain Division on alert. Mizoram CM urges Centre for humanitarian aid.
